title: Stepwise Optimization of a Matrigel-Based In Vitro Angiogenesis Assay for Reproducible and Quantifiable 2D-Tube Formation Using HUVECs.
markdown:
## Protocol: Stepwise optimization of a Matrigel-based in vitro angiogenesis assay for reproducible and quantifiable 2D tube formation using human umbilical vein endothelial cells

### Overview

This protocol outlines the stepwise optimization of a Matrigel-based in vitro angiogenesis assay to achieve reproducible and quantifiable 2D tube formation using human umbilical vein endothelial cells (HUVECs). The procedure covers reagent preparation, cell culture expansion, Matrigel handling and coating, assay medium supplementation, cell seeding, and imaging analysis. Key optimizations include strict temperature control during Matrigel handling to ensure uniform matrix formation, precise passage number constraints for HUVECs to ensure reproducibility, and standardized imaging and analysis parameters using the Angiogenesis Analyzer plugin.

### Materials/Reagents

- Recombinant human VEGF (vascular endothelial growth factor)
- Recombinant human bFGF (basic fibroblast growth factor)
- Human epidermal growth factor (hEGF)
- Bovine brain extract (BBE)
- Hydrocortisone
- Heparan sulfate
- Hepatocyte growth factor (HGF)
- Sterile PBS
- DMEM/Ham's F12 medium (serum-free for dilution; supplemented for expansion)
- Fetal Bovine Serum (FBS)
- Endothelial Basal Medium (EBM)
- Trypsin-EDTA
- Growth factor-reduced Matrigel

### Equipment

- 75 cm² polystyrene culture flasks
- Inverted or Hoffman modulation contrast microscope
- Microscope objectives (4-5x magnification)
- 24-well culture plates
- Pipette tips
- Tubes
- Ice bath or cold room setup
- Incubator or controlled environment at 22°C

### Safety & Sterility

Maintain sterile conditions throughout all steps involving cell culture and reagent preparation. Use sterile PBS for stock solutions. Ensure all materials contacting Matrigel are pre-cooled and handled on ice to prevent premature polymerization while maintaining sterility. Avoid freeze-thaw cycles for both Matrigel aliquots and HUVECs to preserve cell viability and matrix integrity.

## Reagent Preparation

### Pre-assay Preparation

1. Prepare a stock solution of recombinant human VEGF at 40 μg/mL in sterile PBS. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S01 -->
2. Prepare a stock solution of recombinant human bFGF at 40 μg/mL in sterile PBS. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S02 -->
3. Prepare a stock solution of human epidermal growth factor (hEGF) at 10 ng/mL in sterile PBS. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S03 -->
4. Prepare a stock solution of bovine brain extract at 48 μg/mL in sterile PBS. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S04 -->
5. Prepare a stock solution of hydrocortisone at 1 μg/mL in sterile PBS. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S05 -->
6. Prepare a stock solution of heparan sulfate at 0.75 IU/mL in sterile PBS. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S06 -->
7. Prepare a stock solution of hepatocyte growth factor (HGF) at 25 ng/mL in sterile PBS. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B01-T0-S07 -->

## Cell Culture & Expansion

### HUVEC Expansion

1. Use 75 cm² polystyrene culture flasks for HUVEC expansion. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S01 -->
2. Culture HUVECs in DMEM/Ham's F12 medium supplemented with 10% FBS and expand them for at least two passages. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S02 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Ensure HUVECs are expanded for at least two passages prior to use in angiogenesis assays. When derived from primary cultures, use HUVECs between passages 2 and 10 to ensure reproducible angiogenic outcomes. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S03 -->
3. Use HUVECs immediately after detachment with trypsin-EDTA. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S04 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Do not use HUVECs that have undergone freeze-thaw cycles. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B02-T0-S05 -->

## Matrigel Handling & Coating

### Matrigel Thawing

1. Thaw growth factor-reduced Matrigel at 4°C for 24 hours prior to use. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S01 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Ensure Matrigel is thawed at 4°C for at least 24 hours before use. Do not transfer directly from -20°C to room temperature, as this causes rapid gelation and fibril formation, which adversely affects matrix uniformity and cell distribution. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T0-S02 -->

### Matrigel Dilution & Aliquoting

1. Dilute Matrigel in cold, serum-free DMEM/Ham's F12 to a final concentration of 3 mg/mL. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T1-S01 -->
2. Prepare single-use aliquots to avoid repeated freeze-thaw cycles (see Note 4). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T1-S02 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Pre-cool and maintain all materials in contact with Matrigel (pipette tips, tubes, culture plates) on ice during handling. Failure to maintain cold conditions results in premature polymerization and compromised coating uniformity. Dilute Matrigel in cold medium and apply to pre-cooled surfaces. Remove excess Matrigel while still in liquid form to prevent uneven surface topography and wave-like structures. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T1-S03 -->

### Plate Coating

1. Perform all coating steps on ice. Coat 24-well plates with Matrigel at a final concentration of 3 mg/mL by dispensing 100 μL per well to ensure uniform coverage. Gently spread the matrix across the entire well surface under cold conditions and remove excess Matrigel immediately after coating. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T2-S01 -->
2. Incubate coated plates at 22°C for 90 minutes to allow matrix stabilization. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B03-T2-S02 -->

## Assay Medium Preparation

### Medium Supplementation

1. Thaw the aliquoted supplements listed in the Reagent Preparation section at 4°C immediately prior to use and maintain them on ice until use. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S01 -->
2. Use EBM as the culture medium (see Note 7). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S02 -->
3. Supplement the EBM with VEGF (40 ng/mL), bFGF (40 ng/mL), HGF (25 ng/mL), hEGF (10 ng/mL), BBE (48 μg/mL), hydrocortisone (1 μg/mL), and heparan sulfate (0.75 IU/mL). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B04-T0-S03 -->

## Cell Seeding & Assay Setup

### Seeding

1. Seed HUVECs at a density of 20,000 cells/cm². [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T0-S01 -->
2. Ensure uniform distribution of cells across the culture surface upon seeding. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T0-S02 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Maintain cells under serum-free conditions throughout the assay. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T0-S03 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Maintain identical culture conditions across all experimental groups. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T0-S04 -->

### Attachment Phase

1. Allow cells to attach and monitor their initial distribution prior to further analysis. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B05-T1-S01 -->

## Imaging & Analysis

### Monitoring

1. Monitor tube formation at 4-hour intervals using an inverted or Hoffman modulation contrast microscope at 4-5x magnification. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T0-S01 -->

### at 12 h

1. Capture images from at least ﬁve representative ﬁelds per well (see Note 9). [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T1-S01 -->
2. Perform endpoint imaging at 12 hours. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T1-S02 -->
3. Acquire images at 4-5x magnification. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T1-S03 -->
4. Capture at least five representative fields per well under identical imaging conditions. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T1-S04 -->

#### Branch A: Optional Quadrant Sampling

1. Draw two imaginary perpendicular cross-lines centered on the image field. Capture at least one image from each of the four quadrants defined by this coordinate system, as well as one image at the central intersection point. This quadrant sampling approach is optional; acquisition of additional fields is left to the user's discretion. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T1-S05 -->

### Image Analysis

1. Analyze images using the Angiogenesis Analyzer plugin for ImageJ. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T2-S01 -->
> **Operational constraint:** Apply identical analysis settings to all images. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T2-S02 -->
2. Quantify segments and isolated segments to calculate total length. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T2-S03 -->
3. Export quantitative outputs for downstream analysis. [1] <!-- protocol-step:B06-T2-S04 -->

## References

- [1] Stepwise Optimization of a Matrigel-Based In Vitro Angiogenesis Assay for Reproducible and Quantifiable 2D-Tube Formation Using HUVECs. — https://doi.org/10.1007/7651_2026_709
